answer: Farming becomes a dune bet on surviving 44 epochs of grading, and every shale settlement recomputes the jade schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 44 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
